_comment: Hand checks (Dean 24 Oct 09:24) of councils the daily SWEP classifier could not settle (unknown/unreachable). Read-only checks of council pages; nobody contacted. Valid 30 days, then the council returns to the to-check list. result: ok = SWEP described, not active now; old = only an old dated activation notice (not active now); none = page has no SWEP info (better page needed); flag = needs Dean; todo = still unchecked.
